content.text: Search the Lehigh Website SearchX Image Maps & Directions Nested on South Mountain in Bethlehem, Pennsylvania, Lehigh University has one of the most charming and welcoming campuses in the country. Interactive Map The Lehigh campus map provides a fast and convenient way to search for—and navigate to or from—any of the hundreds of offices, departments, facilities and venues located on the university's three contiguous campuses. View our interactive map > Printable Directions & University Maps It’s easy to get to each of Lehigh’s three campuses, and there are parking garages on both sides of the Asa Packer Campus, a number of parking meters both on- and off-campus and free visitor parking lots available on the Mountaintop and Goodman campuses. To see how Lehigh is situated in the Lehigh Valley, download our Regional Travel Maps (PDF). Asa Packer Campus The Admissions Office is on Lehigh's original and most historic campus, where most classrooms, residence halls, dining facilities and libraries are located.Directions to Asa Packer Campus >Asa Packer Campus Map (PDF) Mountaintop Campus Crowning South Mountain, this campus contains the College of Education, Iacocca Hall, Mountaintop Building C, academic departments and major research facilities.Directions to Mountaintop Campus >Mountaintop and Murray H. Goodman Campus Map (PDF) Murray H. Goodman Campus Located on the other side of South Mountain in Saucon Valley, this campus is home to Lehigh's athletic complex, the Murray H. Goodman football stadium, Stabler Arena and the Rauch Fieldhouse.Directions to Goodman Campus >Mountaintop and Murray H. Goodman Campus Map (PDF)For driving directions to additional athletic facilities, visit www.lehighsports.com.
